name: Evelyn Regner - Après le considérant 3 - Am 103
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (3 a) In accordance with the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality set out in Article 5 of the Treaty on European Union, direct taxation policy remains the responsibility of the Member States. This Directive shall in no way lead to binding harmonisation of national tax bases or affect the budgetary sovereignty of Member States.
